name: broad_calendar
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Wednesday September 23, 2026. Scope: Calendar.

Window: Wednesday September 23, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET), after-hours that evening, and overnight/pre-market news through Wednesday September 23, 2026 ~6:00 AM ET.

COVER EVERY ITEM BELOW (run a separate search for each bullet; do not skip one because another was rich)
Scheduled catalysts from the brief date through the next 5 NYSE sessions: earnings (date, BMO/AMC, EPS and revenue consensus) for US stocks >= $10B plus notable mid-caps, investor/analyst days, FDA PDUFA dates, major economic releases with consensus, Fed speakers, options expiry, index rebalances, lockup expiries.

Prefer primary sources and wire services (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's,
company press releases, SEC EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Fed releases).

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar, or
invent a concise one. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source in parentheses: (Reuters), (company 8-K), (CNBC interview),
  (Morgan Stanley note). "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor].
- Only facts published in the window below. Older background only if it is the direct cause of this
  move, and label it with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## **CTAS** — Cintas `[Software & SaaS]`
- Fiscal third-quarter 2026 EPS was **$1.36** versus **$1.35 consensus**; revenue was **$3.01 billion** versus **$2.98 billion consensus**. (Investing.com)
- Cintas issued fiscal 2027 EPS guidance of **$5.45–$5.54** versus **$5.49 consensus**, and revenue guidance of **$12.15–$12.27 billion** versus **$12.22 billion consensus**. (Investing.com)
- The earnings report was scheduled **before the market open on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**. (Newsquawk)

## **GIS** — General Mills `[Consumer Staples]`
- General Mills was scheduled to report **before the market open on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**, with consensus EPS of **$0.72** and revenue of **$4.35 billion**. (Newsquawk)

## **PAYX** — Paychex `[Software & SaaS]`
- Paychex was scheduled to report **before the market open on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**, with consensus EPS of **$1.32** and revenue of **$1.63 billion**. (Newsquawk)

## **DRI** — Darden Restaurants `[Consumer Discretionary]`
- Darden Restaurants was scheduled to report **before the market open on Thursday, September 24, 2026**, with consensus EPS of **$2.05** and revenue of **$3.21 billion**. (Newsquawk)

## **COST** — Costco Wholesale `[Consumer Staples]`
- Costco Wholesale was scheduled to report **after the market close on Thursday, September 24, 2026**, with consensus EPS of **$6.55** and revenue of **$94.86 billion**. (Newsquawk)

## **FUL** — H.B. Fuller `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- H.B. Fuller was scheduled to report **after the market close on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**. (Investrade)

## **NEOV** — NeoGenomics `[Healthcare]`
- NeoGenomics was scheduled to report **after the market close on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**. (Investrade)

## **SFIX** — Stitch Fix `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Stitch Fix was scheduled to report **after the market close on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**. (Investrade)

## **Fed / Macro** — Federal Reserve `[Macro / Calendar]`
- Federal Reserve Governor **Michael S. Barr** was scheduled to speak at **10:05 a.m. EDT on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**, at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago’s Housing Affordability 2026 summit; his subject was **“Economic Outlook and Housing.”** (Federal Reserve Board schedule)
- The September 23 US S&P Global consensus readings were **53.6** for manufacturing PMI, **56.0** for services PMI, and **55.2** for composite PMI. (Global Economy briefing)
- The prior US S&P Global readings were **53.9** for manufacturing PMI, **56.5** for services PMI, and **56.0** for composite PMI. (Global Economy briefing)
- The September 23 US MBA mortgage calendar listed a prior **30-year mortgage rate of 6.97%**, a prior purchase index of **156.2**, and a prior mortgage market index of **230.8**. (Global Economy briefing)
- The September 23 EIA calendar included gasoline stocks and crude-oil-imports data; the listed prior changes were **+0.794 million barrels** for gasoline stocks and **−1.18 million barrels** for crude-oil imports. (Global Economy briefing)

## Options `[Macro / Calendar]`
- FX options expiries for the **10:00 a.m. New York cut on Wednesday, September 23, 2026** included **$664 million** at USD/CAD **1.3655**, **$380 million** at USD/CAD **1.4150**, and **$300 million** at USD/CAD **1.4130**. (Tickmill)

## **BMO** — Bank of Montreal `[Financials]`
- Bank of Montreal reported third-quarter EPS of **$2.84** versus **$2.71 consensus**, and revenue of **$7.10 billion** versus **$6.94 billion expected**. (Ad Hoc News)
- Bank of Montreal reported third-quarter return on equity of **14%** and pre-provision, pre-tax income of **C$4.5 billion**. (Ad Hoc News)

## **AVGO** — Broadcom `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Broadcom’s reported fourth-quarter guidance was described as **12% above consensus** in a September 23 market report. (TickerDaily)

## **AMD** — Advanced Micro Devices `[AI Compute]`
- AMD was listed as scheduled to report **after 4:00 p.m. ET on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**, with consensus EPS of **$1.08** and revenue of **$22.3 billion**. (TickerDaily)

## **QCOM** — Qualcomm `[Wireless & Mobile]`
- Qualcomm was listed as scheduled to report **after 4:00 p.m. ET on Wednesday, September 23, 2026**, with consensus EPS of **$2.89** and revenue of **$9.84 billion**. (TickerDaily)

## **KBH** — KB Home `[Consumer Discretionary]`
- KB Home’s fiscal third-quarter EPS was **$1.05** versus **$0.89 consensus**, and revenue was approximately **$1.3 billion**, described as in line with consensus. (Investrade)
- KB Home’s net orders fell **12% year over year to 2,604**, backlog rose **2% to 4,398 homes**, and backlog value rose **3% to $2.05 billion**. (Investrade)
- KB Home maintained fourth-quarter deliveries of **3,000–3,500 homes** and full-year deliveries of **10,500–11,000 homes**. (Investrade)
- KB Home guided fourth-quarter revenue to **$1.45–$1.65 billion** versus **$1.61 billion consensus**. (Investrade)
